title: Aiko Melendez honors late father Jimi ahead of wedding to Onemig Bondoc
summary: Aiko Melendez remembered her late father, Jimi, on his birthday, sharing how her fiancé, Onemig Bondoc, embodies the kind of love and security she had always hoped to find.
